en: A color postcard showing a small town square with a two‑story neoclassical public building at the center, featuring a symmetrical façade, central portico with four columns, and a tiled gable roof. In front of it is an open paved area with a few trees and people walking. A vintage bus is parked on the left and a blue truck stands closer to the middle. Low hills and green countryside are visible in the background under a blue sky with scattered clouds.
